name: com.webknox/webknox
title: WebKnox
description: Answer cards in the chat: comparisons with photos, weather, nutrition, recipes, media and more.

tools.name: ask_webknox
tools.description: Shows the user an interactive WebKnox answer card, with its sources, for questions that have one: comparisons of two to four things with photos ("ravens vs crows"), weather forecasts for a named place, sunrise, sunset and moon phases, nutrition facts of a food, recipes, translations and word definitions, unit conversions and calculations, the time in a city and countdowns, pictures of a subject, videos, music, radio stations, podcasts and sounds, jokes, quotes, fun facts and what happened on this day, and who a named person is or what a named place or chemical element is, with a photo, a map or its place in the periodic table. It has no cards for explanations, advice, opinions, coding or writing. For a question without a card, the result says so and shows nothing.

question.description: The question as one self-contained sentence in the user's language that names the place, food or things it is about; a follow-up such as "and tomorrow?" written out as a full question.

locale.description: The user's language, for the card's labels: en, de, fr, es, pt or it.

units.description: Units for weather and conversions, when the user prefers one system.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, such as Europe/Berlin, when known.
